diagnose.name: setext-ambiguity
diagnose.message: This line is a Setext heading underline for the previous paragraph, so it renders as a heading instead of a horizontal rule. Insert a blank line above it, or use *** for a rule.

fix.reason: A fix would turn a leading --- into YAML frontmatter. Fix the first lines manually; use *** if the line was meant as a horizontal rule.
